comment: One real vendor wire id (`response.model` / `modelId` as the vendor's API actually returns it) for every entry in data/known-models.json. Both the TS suite (tests/ts/known-models-reachability.test.ts) and the Python suite (python/tests/ai_bom/test_parse_model_id.py) parse each id with their own parseModelId and assert it lands on exactly one bundled entry, and that every bundled entry is reached; tests/cross-sdk/test_model_id_parity.py asserts the two parsers agree on all of them. Adding a bundled entry without a row here fails all three — that is the point: an entry keyed on a shape no vendor id produces can never be reached.
